IGroupWebService
@Dependent @Named("scim2GroupEndpoint") @Path("/v2/Groups") public class GroupWebService extends BaseScimWebService implements IGroupWebService
Implementation of /Groups endpoint. Methods here are intercepted. Filter io.jans.scim.service.filter.AuthorizationProcessingFilter secures invocations
